services.name: Waikiki Group Snorkel Adventure
services.desc: Looking to get out on the water but don’t need a full private boat? Our Join a Group Snorkel Cruise is designed for travelers who want the Tradewind Charters experience at a per-person rate. Departing from Honolulu’s south shore, just minutes from Waikiki, you’ll join other guests on an afternoon ride along the coastline before mooring at one of our favorite snorkel spots with clear water and abundant marine life. Relax on deck as we cruise toward Diamond Head, then slip into the water to look for Hawaiian green sea turtles, reef fish, and other local marine life. Your captain and crew will 2-Hour Waikiki Snorkel Experience · 8AM, 10AM & 2PM Departure

quotes.text: I had a WONDERFUL experience. Captain Ken was incredibly responsive and easy to coordinate with. He and his crew made sure that we had an enjoyable and safe time out on the water. The boat was incredibly clean, and well-equipped with everything you would need - snorkels, bathrooms, and a full bar! Can't wait to sail again with Tradewind Charters.

This was an amazing way to end our vacation in Hawaii. Our family sailed for two hours and enjoyed the sunset while eating and drinking. Best of all it was just us! Our own private cruise. Paul was an incredible captain and host who took care of all of our needs. We just sat back and enjoyed the ride.

A group of four of us took a morning sailing cruise out past the shores of Waikiki. Captain Nate was a great source of information and shared some fantastic recommendations of things to see/do. He was very personable and informative and made our trip very enjoyable.

My family thoroughly enjoyed a three-hour sail trip on "My Sunshine." Captain Paul was amazing, as was the boat trip. Beautiful say on Waikiki swimming, sailing and enjoying the sun. Perfect cruise!!!!
